text:
Eli: Heads-up  last QA pass for tomorrow's launch newsletter. Need final segment mapping + send cadence. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/example

Rina: Segments: beta-invite (3.8k), active-users (29k), newsletter-only (88k). Beta gets preview CTA, active gets case study CTA, newsletter-only gets TL;DR.

Marta: Deliverability note: cap newsletter-only at 7k/hr and rotate domains. Seed 50 internal users across Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo for inbox checks.

Josh: A/B plan: active-users gets Subject A/B; beta-invite single subject with personalized salutation. newsletter-only control-only for deliverability baseline.

Eli: Timezone windows: APAC 1100-1400 local, EMEA 0900-1100 local, US 1300-1500 local. Map tz by user profile then fallback to country.

Marta: Suppressions: global opt-outs, hard bounces, support tickets last 72h. Pause threshold: bounce >1% or complaints >0.05% in 1h.

Rina: Copy notes: keep preheader <90 chars. Beta CTA: "Request preview". Active CTA: "Apply config". Provide plain-text version and alt text for images.

send-ops-bot: Waves scheduled:
- seed_preview ts=1777004000 recipients=50
- active_wave ts=1777010000 recipients=29000 variants=A/B ramp=10/40/50
- newsletter_wave ts=1777025000 recipients=88000 window=48h chunk=4

Eli: Owners: Marta runs domain rotation + warmup tonight, Rina finalizes copy by 5pm PT, Josh prepares variants, I'll own post-send dashboard. Reconvene after seed wave for quick checks. :thumbsup:
